units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:24">Targ. Gen. II, 24</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 63a:11">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>באתר דלית ג׳ כ׳</he> where there is no man, (leader).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 97a:3">B. Mets. 97ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>ג׳ דנשי וכ׳</he> for a man whom women killed there is no law or judge.

Men. 42ᵇ, a. e. חובת ג׳ personal duty, opp. ח׳ טלית the duty resting on the garment (whether or not you wear it).—ההוא גברא a certain man. B. Mets. l. c.; a. v. fr. [Frequ. האי גברא, or ההוא, euphem. for I, or thou; v. ההוא.]—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 36a:11">Bekh. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>בלא גברא</he> (Rashi <he>גברי</he>) without naming an authority.—Pl. <he>גַּבְרִין</he>, <he>גַּבְרַיָּיא</he>, <he>גַּבְרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 1:13">Targ. O. Deut. I, 13</cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:4">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>יהוון גַּבְ׳ בכל מילייא</he> (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2:4">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>גּוּבְרִין</he>) they shall be strong (trained) in all things.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:17">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>כד הוינן זוטרי לג׳ וכ׳</he> when we were young, we were esteemed as men, now that we are old &c.; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 53b:8">Ib. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>סימן דגברי ש̇ק̇ ז̇ר̇ף̇</he> the mnemonical sign for the authorities quoted is &c. (<he>ש̇שת</he>, <he>לק̇יש</he>, <he>אלעז̇ר</he>, <he>ר̇בא</he>, <he>פ̇פא</he>).—Fem. <cite ref="C00138"><he>גְּבַרְתָּא</he></cite>, only assumed for argument, v. <cite ref="A02314"><he>אַנְתְּרוֹפִי</he></cite>. V. also <cite ref="C00292"><he>גּוּבְרָא</he></cite>.
